name: Sepang International Circuit
source: Shared centreline for Orbit Sepang (sepang.glb), CircuitFlyoverHero, SepangCircuitMap, and scripts/generate_circuit_models.py. Close honest apex points with elevation — not a laser survey. Same honesty standard as the strategy engine. 'Back Straight Mid' sits between T14 and T15 Hairpin, matching Sepang's real 927m back straight — the track's longest straight, running back alongside the pit straight in the opposite direction and joining it only via the T15 hairpin (driver61.com's circuit guide) — not between T4 and T5 as an earlier revision of this file wrongly assumed. The point originally shipped in the right place but with a coordinate skewed toward the front straight, which visibly pinched/self-crossed the derived path; corrected by interpolating between T14 and T15's own existing points rather than inventing a new unverified coordinate.
